text.tspan: MAIN level application flow path symbol.
Starts from its ring and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
Can ONLY return to Home Screen.
ROOT level application flow path symbol.
Starts from its ring and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
ROOT level application flow path symbol.
Support both directions of the flow process and can start from any side,
and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
Can start from both sides and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
Can ONLY return to its parent screen.
Can start from both sides and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
Can return to its parent screen or to the Home Screen.
Can start from both sides and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
Starts from its ring and ends with an arrow that declares its directional path.
